name: PAMELA
full_name: Payload for Antimatter Matter Exploration and Light-nuclei Astrophysics
summary: Historical space magnetic spectrometer whose cosmic-antiparticle measurements provide positron and antiproton spectra for indirect dark-matter searches.
detection_principle: A permanent magnet measures rigidity and charge sign; multiple particle-identification detectors jointly reject ordinary matter and hadronic backgrounds.

status.label: Data taking ended / historical experiment
status.evidence: The current project homepage explicitly describes ten years of data taking until the host satellite stopped in 2016.

collaboration.name: PAMELA collaboration / mission team
collaboration.participants_note: Institutional participation refers to the period covered by each source; this dossier does not claim to provide a complete membership list.

results.summary: Measured a positron-fraction excess; dark-matter, pulsar and propagation explanations must be distinguished. The antiproton spectrum is compatible with secondary production.

science_scope: Tests dark-matter models through astrophysical radiation, cosmic rays or neutrinos. Astrophysical backgrounds and propagation models affect interpretation; an anomaly alone does not establish dark matter.
